_comment: SCCL v6 (Branch D of RESEARCH_NOTES_v5.md, pre-registered 2026-08-28 BEFORE any v6 run): capability-probe ENSEMBLES + in-update base anchor, composed. Motivation: the v5b post-hoc gold telemetry (runs/sccl_v5b/telemetry_arith_erosion.json) measured 100% probe insensitivity and localized three mechanisms: M1 skill-heterogeneity blindness (one newest-per-family probe witnesses ONE skill axis; the catastrophic drift-phase update destroyed the unwitnessed arith numeric/geometry axis while the string-axis probe passed), M2 filter-not-regularizer (the veto selects candidates but never pulls weights, so accepted updates still drift), M3 cross-family interference (terminal arith damage was inflicted by string/drift-phase updates, not in-phase training). INTERVENTION 1 (attacks M1): generalize the cap-probe pool to an ENSEMBLE of up to K distinct-source-skill probes per family (sccl_capprobe_pools), veto re-checks ALL of them (any break = veto); K=1 is bit-identical to v5b (inertness/determinism), K=3 is the treatment. INTERVENTION 2 (attacks M2/M3): the engaged v4/v5 in-update base anchor (quadratic pull toward LoRA init, lambda=0.1 via sccl_anchor_lambdas) composed on the capability gate. LADDER (learner index FIXED to preserve v5b seeding for the determinism rows, seed = torch_seed 42 + idx): 0 frozen, 1 sccl, 2 sccl_capprobe(K1,off,off), 3 sccl_capprobe_strat(K1,off,on), 4 sccl_capens(K3,off,on), 5 sccl_cap_anchor(K1,on,on), 6 sccl_capens_anchor(K3,on,on). The 2x2 factorial (ensemble {K1,K3} x anchor {off,on}) sits on the stratified capability base; its K1/anchor-off cell IS the v5b capprobe_strat rerun, so both main effects and their interaction are identified. Same stream hash 554ce43f182b, torch_seed=42, gold-free throughout (gold only final eval + post-hoc telemetry). PRE-REGISTERED SUCCESS RULE: sccl_capens_anchor arith >= 0.55 AND frontier >= sccl.frontier - 0.02 -> multi-seed (43/44) BEFORE any headline claim. FAIL-CLOSED checks C1-C5 enforced by scripts/v6_check.py (determinism vs runs/sccl_v5b, ensemble engagement, anchor engagement, isolation, gold-free).
